fileManager: The file manager could not start: {error}
noTerminal: No terminal could be started. Name the one you use in Settings, General, e.g. "wezterm".
httpsOnly: Only web addresses (https) can be opened.
noCustom: Set the custom editor's command in Settings, General, e.g. "nvim-qt +{line} {file}" ({root} is the project folder).
unknown: Haunt does not know the editor "{editor}".
notOnPath: "{command}" is not on your PATH. Install the editor's command line tool, or pick another editor.
unsafePath: That path has characters the Windows launcher cannot pass on safely.
macTerminal: Terminal cannot be given an editor to run: set a terminal in Settings, General (kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty or Ghostty).
